changes: Closed a real eligibility loophole: winning a Casino Pot share was itself counting as "real XP" toward qualifying for the NEXT period too, even with zero plays. Fixed both client and server, and found/fixed a related gap where the server was missing several games from its own exclusion list.
Video Poker's bet chip is now clickable for a custom amount, same as Mines already allows.
Floor activity feed extended from the last 50 entries to the last 100.

Fixed the actual root cause of the chat scroll bug (found via live DevTools) — the message list was a flex container with justify-content:flex-end while also being the scroll container, a real browser quirk that can make overflow at the top genuinely unreachable by scrolling.
